findings.summary: Reads like an unreviewed autofix sweep (AI-policy concern); TokenProxy.__slots__ lists a logger attribute it doesn't have
Memory claim has no script or build info, and mypyc-compiled classes don't benefit
Base(ABC) makes isinstance checks about 4.4x slower on the hot path and BasePattern becomes instantiable
Body claims about removed allocations contradict the diff (extra copies in __str__ and update_sibling_maps)
used_names removal is half done; Parser still builds it
eq=False/repr=False on dataclasses saves no memory and costs debuggability
__slots__ = () is a no-op where the bases have no slots
Unrelated stylistic rewrites (should_hug, __str__, diff(), pgen.py, pytree helpers, etc.) belong in their own PR
Leaf constructor rewrite changes prefix behavior for no gain
No tests or benchmark reproduction, no compiled-build CI evidence

why: Finding 8 says many unrelated stylistic hunks touching no memory belong in their own PR, which matches the maintainer's 'no clear focus, many small opinionated changes' reason. Finding 1 is about AI-style sweeps and not the same cause.
